<!-- PHI-DIRECT -->
```powershell
Write-Output '=== DT DIALOGUE MERGE - THE O ROWS STAND IN THE BASE TABLE (Golden Eye missing piece M5, authored from job 350s census, read whole: VEIL DT_Dialogue carries exactly V01 to V19, OMNI carries exactly O01 to O18, and both tables share the one row struct PHIDialogueRow with fields Speaker and Line. Job 349s ported quest beats call FPHIVoice rows O01 to O18 and print PHI VOICE MISS until those rows stand in the base table; job 353 already ported the 18 clips themselves. THIS JOB merges the tables: step one runs an editor commandlet in the OMNI project that exports its 18 rows (Speaker and Line per row) to a JSON file in the VEIL Saved folder; step two runs an editor commandlet in the VEIL project that adds every O row to the base DT_Dialogue, saves the asset, and prints the row census after. The VEIL table is backed up first. Verification rides in the same job: a strings census of the merged package must read 37 rows with O01 to O18 present. If an API surface differs, the scripts print the exact API census and the export half still lands, so the reroute is written from a read. OMNI-UE is read-only here; the parent stands.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 8) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'EDITOR STILL OPEN after 2 min - job deferred.'; Write-Output 'JOB 355 DEFERRED'; return }
$cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
$veilDT = 'D:\VEIL\Content\Data\DT_Dialogue.uasset'
Copy-Item $veilDT "$veilDT.phi-backup-355" -Force
Write-Output 'VEIL DT BACKED UP (.phi-backup-355)'
$pyExp = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyExp = $pyExp.Replace('OUTFILE', "'D:\OMNI-UE\Saved\phi_dt_export_out.txt'").Replace('JSONOUT', "'D:\VEIL\Saved\phi_dt_omni_rows.json'")
Set-Content 'D:\OMNI-UE\Saved\phi_dt_export.py' -Value $pyExp -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item 'D:\OMNI-UE\Saved\phi_dt_export_out.txt' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$uprojO = Get-ChildItem 'D:\OMNI-UE' -Filter '*.uproject' -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
& $cmdexe $uprojO -run=pythonscript -script='D:\OMNI-UE\Saved\phi_dt_export.py' -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> 'D:\OMNI-UE\Saved\dtmerge355_export.log'
if (Test-Path 'D:\OMNI-UE\Saved\phi_dt_export_out.txt') { Get-Content 'D:\OMNI-UE\Saved\phi_dt_export_out.txt' | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT EXPORT OUTPUT FILE'; Write-Output 'JOB 355 STOPPED'; return }
if (-not (Test-Path 'D:\VEIL\Saved\phi_dt_omni_rows.json')) { Write-Output 'DT ROWS JSON MISSING - import half not run.'; Write-Output 'JOB 355 STOPPED'; return }
$pyImp = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyImp = $pyImp.Replace('OUTFILE', "'D:\VEIL\Saved\phi_dt_import_out.txt'").Replace('JSONIN', "'D:\VEIL\Saved\phi_dt_omni_rows.json'")
Set-Content 'D:\VEIL\Saved\phi_dt_import.py' -Value $pyImp -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item 'D:\VEIL\Saved\phi_dt_import_out.txt' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$uprojV = Get-ChildItem 'D:\VEIL' -Filter '*.uproject' -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
& $cmdexe $uprojV -run=pythonscript -script='D:\VEIL\Saved\phi_dt_import.py' -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> 'D:\VEIL\Saved\dtmerge355_import.log'
if (Test-Path 'D:\VEIL\Saved\phi_dt_import_out.txt') { Get-Content 'D:\VEIL\Saved\phi_dt_import_out.txt' | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT IMPORT OUTPUT FILE'; Write-Output 'JOB 355 STOPPED'; return }
$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($veilDT)
$text = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bytes)
$ids = [regex]::Matches($text, '[VO][0-9][0-9]') | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Sort-Object -Unique
Write-Output ("PHI DT MERGED CENSUS rows=" + $ids.Count + " : " + ($ids -join ' '))
Write-Output 'JOB 355 DONE'
```
